title: Incognito
summary: Kerry wants one street food meal in Japantown without anyone lifting a phone, so he asks you to run interference in a hat and scarf.

start.bringUp: You have not eaten at a street stall in twelve years because somebody always lifts a phone. You want to cross the Japantown night food street in a hat and scarf and have V run interference. Ask V for it in your own way, with a dry joke that hides how much you want it.

street.name: the entrance of the Japantown night food street

fan-spot.name: the lantern corner halfway down the food street

guard-spot.name: the noodle bar gate on the food street

drone-spot.name: the open square at the middle of the food street

stall.name: the food stall at the end of the street

K2.open.01.text: I haven't eaten at a stall in twelve years. Somebody always lifts a phone.

K2.open.02.text: Hat. Scarf. Glasses. You run interference. If anyone looks, you distract them.

K2.bark.fan.a.text: Shit. Teenager at two o'clock. Do something.

K2.bark.fan.b.text: He saw me. He's looking. Distract him!

K2.bark.safe.b.text: That worked. I'm almost enjoying this.

K2.bark.phone.a.text: Phone up. Damn. Back up, back up.

K2.bark.phone.b.text: That's it. Seen. We try again.

K2.close.01.text: Look at that. A kid. Hand me the coaster. I'll sign it.

K2.close.02.text: We got seen. It's fine. It was a good bowl.

g1.asks: Do I look like a nobody? Honestly. Don't flatter me.
g1.know: You are planning the walk through the Japantown night food street with V. The route is about 600 metres with five points, and there are three ways to be recognized: a teenage fan, a guard who lifts a phone, and a paparazzi drone.
g1.secret: You miss not being recognized, and you also need it.
g1.wants: V to take the job seriously.

g2.asks: Does it taste better because nobody knows who I am? Or just because it's cheap?
g2.know: You are at the stall with a bowl in front of you, relaxed for the first time all night. A small kid is about to recognize you. You told V the stall beats any restaurant you own.
g2.secret: You wanted a kid to recognize you tonight.

stages.label: Kerry asks V to keep an eye out
stages.know: You have asked V to run interference for one meal on the Japantown night food street. You have a hat, a scarf and glasses. You need V to take it seriously.
stages.wants: V to say yes and mean it.

stages.label: Kerry crosses the food street in a hat and scarf
stages.know: You are walking the Japantown night food street with V in a hat and scarf. A teenage fan is near the lanterns, a guard by the noodle bar can lift a phone, and a drone hangs over the square. If the phone goes up, the route is over.
stages.wants: V to get you to the stall without anyone seeing.

stages.label: Kerry eats at the stall with V
stages.know: You are sitting at the food stall at the end of the street with a bowl. You are relaxed, and a small kid nearby is about to recognize you.

stages.label: A small kid recognizes Kerry at the stall
stages.know: You are leaving the stall and a small kid has seen you. You can still say something to the kid, or let it happen.
stages.wants: The kid to get a signature.

unmasked.memory: You walked Kerry through a Japantown night market unrecognized, and he signed a coaster for one kid when he was.
unmasked.history: He wears a hat when V suggests it.

seen.memory: A phone went up at the food street, and Kerry had to walk away from the bowl with you.

retreat.memory: You called off the route and walked Kerry back to the car without the bowl.
